page.layout: One page of text, with two round coin illustrations at the top (no text blocks beside them other than the coin legends, which are part of the engravings and are not transcribed). Running head at the top: page number left, title centred. Main text is one column, followed by a short paragraph beginning with a small capitalised name line below.

main_text.l: POMPEIVS, parta ingenti felicitate,& celeritate de pi-
ratis victoria, mox bellum contra Mithridatem suscepit anno
mundi 3897. ante Christum natum 65. quem in Armenia
minore nocturno prælio vicit,ac 40000.eius militum occisis,
30.tantum de exercitu suo perdidit:Mithridates cum vxore &
duobus ex suis fugit.Tigranes maioris Armeniæ rex Pōpeio se
dedidit,ad genua eius procubuit, in cuius manus diadema col-
locauit,quod ei repofuit Pompeius.Orodē Albanorum regem
vicit:rogatus,veniam ei ac pacem cōceffit.Iberiæ quoq; regem
acie vicit. Armeniam minorem Deiotaro Galatiæ regi dedit,
quòd opem tuliffet ei aduerfus Mithridatē. Attalo & Pyleme-
ni Paphlagoniam tradidit. Ariftarchum Colchis regem impo-
fuit.Mox Iturǣos & Arabes vicit.Seleucia Antiochiæ vicinam,
libertate donauit, quòd Tigranem non recepiffet:Antiochēsi-
bus obsides reddidit. Inde ad Iudæam transgressus, Ierosoly-
mam tertio mense capit:12000.Iudæorum occidit, reliquos in
fidem accipit. Post aliquot annos exarsit bellū ciuile(commu-
ne potius,ac plus quàm bellum vocat Florus)omniū turbulen-
tiss.ac pestilentiss. inter Pompeiū & Cæsarem. Primo congres-
su victus & fugatus Cæsar,euasit:quia noćte interueniēte Pom-
peius sequi noluit:dixitque Cæsar, nec Pompeium scire vincere:&
illo tantùm die se potuisse superari.Deinde apud Pharsaliam pugna-
tur,vtrinque summa contentione : victus tamen Pompeius ad
Ptolemæum,cui tutor à senatu datus fuerat,fugit. is fortunam
magis quàm amicitiā secutus,Pompeium occidit anno mundi
3917. ante Christum natum 45. Vide Eutro. libr. 6. Plutar. in
Pom.Appia li.2.Iosep.lib.14.cap.8.
IVLIA C. Cæsaris & Corneliæ filia, Pompeij fuit vxor,
quæ dum filiam parit,emoritur.

page.notes: Two coin illustrations at the top of the page, with legends "MAGNVS PL POM" (left) and "IVLIA C CAES F POMPEI VXOR" (right); the legends belong to the engravings and are not transcribed as text. The second paragraph is set in a larger, spaced heading style and is treated as a level 2 heading. Possible printing errors left as printed: "Pōpeio", "Orodē", "Antiochēsi-bus", "noćte" (appears to be a printed mark over the e), "Pompeium scire vincere" (printed in italic). Scanned lines are slightly unclear in places; reading of "Mithridatē" and "vicit,ac 40000" is best effort.
